name: Helio Brace
bio: Lisbon-based composer working at the intersection of ambient electronic and orchestral folk. Three albums in five years.

name: Tessa Mira
bio: Seattle indie pop. Crystal vocals over reverb-drenched guitars. The 2024 album made every year-end list.

name: DJ Ferrier
bio: Nairobi-born, Berlin-based. Afrohouse and progressive techno. Festival headliner since 2022.

name: The Quiet Hours
bio: Reykjavik post-rock quartet. Cinematic crescendos, cello-heavy.

name: Mara Sokol
bio: Brooklyn songwriter. Folk-leaning, intimate. Recorded mostly in her living room.

name: Voltaic
bio: London electronic producer. Late-night, bass-forward. Influenced by UKG and 2-step.

name: Kindred Astronaut
bio: Glasgow shoegaze revival. Wall-of-sound guitars, dreamy male/female trade-offs.

name: Soraya
bio: Argentinian R&B / neo-soul. Recorded between Buenos Aires and London.
